title: "Leo P. Geary" – portrait of Air Force U-2 project officer (Chapter 2, p. 62)
description: Very dark black-and-white portrait photograph, captioned "Leo P. Geary," with the subject barely visible in the scan. The text discusses Shell Oil's development of special low-vapor-pressure LF-1A fuel for the U-2 and the problem of keeping pilots alive at extreme altitudes.
